messages:
Samir Patel: Heads up: noticed a steady rise in WS reconnects in ap-southeast-1 starting ~14:12 UTC. ~2x baseline sustained for 8 minutes. Any recent rollouts?
Elena Gomez: I saw the spike on the reconnect heatmap. No model change, but infra teams started a routing policy tweak at 14:10 to prefer regional fallback for sticky sessions.
Ravi Singh: Looking at routing logs: sessions that hit fallback route are getting a short-lived lease (ttl=3s) on the new pool, then reconnect immediately. snippet:
``
[2026-03-21T14:11:23Z] route_decision session=s-77 old_shard=shard-a new_shard=shard-b lease_ttl=3s
[2026-03-21T14:11:26Z] client_reconnect session=s-77 attempt=1
```
Nina Park: That ttl=3s is from the rollout jitter config (tries to age leases faster on fallback). Might be too aggressive for long-lived streaming apps.
Samir Patel: Console: can we surface lease_ttl and route_policy in the session table? Right now it's hard to tie the policy flip to reconnects.
Elena Gomez: Agree. Also telemetry gap: metrics-bot shows resume_success_rate unchanged but reconnect_rate up. Looks like resume path works but new-lease path causes churn.
metrics-bot: metric snapshot: reconnect_rate=2.1x baseline, resume_success_rate=0.99, resume_billing_dupes=0.02% (elevated)
Ravi Singh: Billing subtlety: one tenant saw two resume billing events when the client retried during lease reassign. We should ensure the resume endpoint is idempotent across in-flight route handoffs.
Nina Park: UX/rollout question: the new fallback routing was shipped as a traffic-splitting rollout (50% global fallback -> regional fallback). Did we include sticky-lease preservation logic in the new path?
Elena Gomez: It was intended, but looks like the preservation only applied if route matched hash; fallback path created fresh leases. That's the bug.
Samir Patel: Mitigation: 1) reduce fallback rollout to 0% for streaming tenants, 2) increase lease_ttl back to baseline (30s) while we patch, 3) add console alert for route_policy changes impacting sticky=true sessions. Thoughts?
Ravi Singh: +1. I'll open INF ticket and a quick revert PR for the routing config. Also will add an idempotency token check in resume handler to prevent double billing on race.
Nina Park: For the console: I'll file a UI card to add columns: route_policy, lease_ttl, and a trace link. Also propose a new aggregated panel: reconnects_by_route_policy.
Elena Gomez: We should also add a small e2e in the routing sim: simulate fallback route with concurrent resume and ensure single billing and no reconnect spike.
deploy-bot: routing-config-revert -> started at 14:28 UTC by Ravi S.
metrics-bot: alert fired: reconnect_rate_by_route_policy > 1.5x baseline for streaming=true tenants.
Samir Patel: Revert complete at 14:33 UTC. reconnects trending down; watching for 10 minutes.
Elena Gomez: Postmortem items: 1) patch fallback path to preserve sticky lease metadata, 2) add routing sim test and meter assertion for resume billing, 3) console UX changes (columns + panel), 4) rollout checklist: flag streaming tenants to exclude from certain fallback behaviors.
Ravi Singh: INF-4321 created with follow-ups and PR links. I'll land the resume idempotency fix today.
Nina Park: I'll prototype the console changes and attach mockups to INF-4321.
Samir Patel: Thanks team. Nice quick revert. Let's keep an eye during the next rollout. :thumbsup:
